figurative_meaning_en: Sense of propriety, common sense or awareness of right and wrong
example_sentences_in_bangla: তালজ্ঞান হারিয়ে ফেলেছো নাকি? এমন কাজ করছ কেন?
example_sentences_in_english: Have you lost your sense of propriety? Why are you doing this?
Keep your common sense and speak now.
note: The idiom draws from musical rhythm to metaphorically indicate loss of judgment in social or behavioral contexts.
